newsitem.title: USA: DT Industries to buy manufacturer.
newsitem.headline: DT Industries to buy manufacturer.

text.p: DT Industries Inc said Tuesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Hansford Manufacturing Corp, a privately held designer and manufacturer of assembly automation systems.
The acquisition is subject to bank approval and other conditions. No financial terms were released.
DT Industries said two weeks ago it was negotiating the potential acquisition of Hansford, which is based in Rochester, N.Y.

DT Industries designs, makes and integrates automated production equipment used to manufacture or package industrial and consumer products. The company also produces precision metal components for a broad range of industrial applications and wear parts for the knitting industry.
